basics.name: Xavier Saliniere
basics.label: Senior Full-Stack Developer
basics.summary: Senior Full-Stack Developer with a frontend focus and over 10 years of experience building enterprise applications in security, operations, and data analytics. Expert in building high-autonomy, output-based systems, including AI-powered customer support platforms and decentralized P2P infrastructure. I have 6 years of experience with Angular, 4 years with Vue.js, 6 years with Java (including 3 with Spring Boot), and 3 years with Python Django.

work.name: Talan
work.summary: Senior Consultant specializing in complex enterprise architecture. Currently focusing on R&D for decentralized infrastructure and AI agent orchestration.

work.name: Bell Canada (via Talan)
work.summary: At Bell Canada's Operations Center, I led full-stack development for enterprise security and analytics platforms, building mission-critical tools for data visualization and real-time monitoring.
highlights: Development of the Insights platform (Vue3/Spring Boot) — AI-powered customer service analytics platform used by over 1,100 users. Built a conversational agent from scratch, enabling natural language querying of the customer service interaction database as well as chart generation.

Created the new Frontend application for the WAF management platform — Migration of the React frontend to Vue3. Features including firewall policy configuration, virtual servers, and real-time telemetry integration with F5 and backend Go/Spring Boot services.
Took over development of the vulnerability management platform — Platform for tracking and remediating security vulnerabilities across Bell's entire infrastructure (Vue2/Django).
Development of the EDR platform — Event detection and response platform for real-time coordination of security incidents with SentinelOne integration (Vue2/Spring Boot).
Development of the new Phisherman Frontend — Phishing detection and analysis platform, integrating URLScan.io, Symantec, and Wildfire (Vue3/Django, Elasticsearch).
Took over development of SLURP — Asset management system with barcode tracking and application health monitoring (Vue2/Django).
Created the UCDB (Unified Configuration Database) platform with API documentation and field management (Vue3/Spring Boot).

work.name: Renault Digital (via Onepoint)
work.summary: Led the Frontend architecture of PRISM — a modular web application for automotive component definition and validation, used by multiple stakeholder roles throughout the vehicle development lifecycle.
highlights: Architected the PRISM modular frontend in Angular 8+, implementing a complex Redux-driven state management system to enable parallel validation of automotive parts across a single source of truth.
Established coding standards, architectural decisions, and development practices for the frontend team; integrated with Java/Spring Boot backend services and collaborated on API contract design.
Reduced automotive component validation cycle time by resolving design conflicts earlier in the phase, preventing costly later-stage manufacturing changes.

work.name: Yanport
work.summary: Full-Stack development of property aggregation and estimation platforms for real estate professionals in France.
highlights: Modernized the real estate analytics portal by migrating the frontend from AngularJS to Angular 5, improving development productivity through TypeScript, reusable components, and a more maintainable architecture.

Engineered key components of a national-scale data pipeline to aggregate property listings across France, implementing resilient scrapers with proxy rotation and regex-based extraction to deduplicate and structure data from millions of records.
